reaches the same target by a different splitting construction; both files are standalone).
- Deliverable: `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1808G3FinalActual.lean` (17209 bytes, SHA256
  `EF72AE9128E3F8BA403B05E8CBC60ED708E0742ACEA127F808F23A56C8E469AC`); olean
  `.lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1808G3FinalActual.olean` (539752 bytes,
  2026-11-01 02:24:00).
- `S1808.epiSurjective`: make A a B-algebra via phi; `Algebra.Etale B A`,
  `Module.Finite B A`; test algebra `A (x)_B A` finite etale over K; epi applied to
  `includeLeft`/`includeRight` gives `Algebra.IsEpi B A`; Mathlib
  `Algebra.isEpi_iff_surjective_algebraMap_of_finite` gives surjectivity. (Same Mathlib route
  as S1797; no product decomposition needed.)
- `S1808.surjectiveSplit`: product-of-separable-fields decomposition
  (`Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod`) + per-component `S1747.exists_factor`; sigma_i
  bijective; index map `m` injective by the 1/0 test; complement
  `C = prod_{j not in range m} B_j`; the map `f = phi.prod (q ∘ eB) : B -> A x C` is proved
  bijective directly (injectivity: A-component determines the range coordinates, C-component the
  complement; surjectivity: overwrite an arbitrary preimage outside range m), then
  `AlgEquiv.ofBijective`; first projection is phi by `AlgHom.fst_prod`. This avoids constructing
  an explicit right inverse (S1797's route) and needs no `eqRec` transport lemmas.
- Derived in the same file: `S1808.monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand` (S1786 shape),
  `S1808.monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand'` (S1793/S1767 shape), `S1808.preGaloisCategory`
  (S1793 category) and `S1808.preGaloisCategory'` (literal
  `PreGaloisCategory ((CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K)^op)`, unconditional: all five fields actual),
  plus `S1808.galoisCategory` conditional only on `S1793GaloisAssembly.FiberFunctorField`.
- Verification: `lake env lean -j1 -R 'D:\lean' -o
  .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1808G3FinalActual.olean
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1808G3FinalActual.lean` -> EXIT=0, no errors, no warnings.
  `#print axioms` for all nine declarations (including the two helpers) -> exactly
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`, no `sorryAx`. Import check
  `_S1808FinalImportCheck.lean` (imports the olean; applies epiSurjective/surjectiveSplit and
  builds the unconditional PreGaloisCategory at the literal opposite category) -> EXIT=0.
- Reusable pitfalls encountered: (1) in a dependent Pi, `if k = i then a else 0` is ill-typed;
  use `Pi.single i a`. (2) For the existential `∃ (C) (_ : CommRing C) ... (e : B ≃ₐ A × C)`,
  register `letI` instances for C *before* defining the splitting `AlgHom`; otherwise the
  explicit instance binders and the type of the AlgEquiv use different instance terms and
  `AlgEquiv.ofBijective` no longer typechecks. (3) `simp [e]` on a `have e : B ≃ₐ ...` is
  rejected (not a let-declaration); inline the term and rewrite with
  `AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_ofBijective`.
- Environment note: many concurrent lake/lean processes; intermittent
  "failed to read file ...olean" errors occurred on this shared workspace, all final builds
  succeeded on retry.
